visual_brief.subject: GPT-6.1 Sol cost per completed task
verified_context: OpenAI kept GPT-6.1 Sol standard input and output pricing at Sol levels while lowering cached-input pricing and reporting stronger agentic task results.
The engineering comparison is total work required to reach an accepted result, not a literal measured path length or invented chart.
Benchmark and cost-per-task comparisons remain vendor-reported and must not be visualized as precise data.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Two workflows can reach the same accepted result with very different total work.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Two tactile paths begin with equivalent small pieces, one winding through a long sequence of structures and the other taking a compact route, before converging on the same terracotta outcome.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant bridge-and-labyrinth metaphor with strong editorial presence, but the shared-result relationship is less immediate because the routes do not converge as clearly.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. A long layered route and a compact route carry equivalent pieces toward the same terracotta result. The physical landscape keeps the idea illustrative rather than infographic-like and avoids gears, labels, and fake metrics.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant long architectural path versus short framed path. Very clear silhouette, but its stronger symmetry makes it read slightly closer to a designed comparison diagram than B.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1600 × 900 hero crop retains both route structures and their common terracotta outcome with comfortable negative space.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop keeps the compact route, enough of the longer route, and the shared endpoint visible without creating a chart-like split-screen.
crop_review.reference_layout: Wide cover inspection preserves the physical depth and converging result while avoiding a bare schematic silhouette.
crop_review.thumbnail: At small scale the long-versus-short route contrast and shared endpoint remain legible.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared palette, graphite/charcoal restraint, terracotta emphasis, tactile paper-like materiality, physical depth, negative space, focal hierarchy, and thumbnail silhouette against the current model/inference production references.
